caption.SceneDescription: The video captures a forward-tracking shot down a narrow, cobblestone street in a European town under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. The architecture features traditional half-timbered buildings and pastel-colored facades with shuttered windows. Pedestrians walk along the street, some carrying backpacks, while others stroll leisurely. On the right, a cafe displays outdoor seating with stacked chairs and tables. The lighting is natural and sunny, casting soft shadows on the ground. The atmosphere is calm and urban, depicting a typical day in a historic district.

editmeta.edit_instruction_1: Add a massive, intricate steampunk-style tunnel structure composed of interlocking golden gears, pipes, and mechanical components that spans the entire width of the cobblestone street and extends into the distance as a continuous archway, with a bright, glowing light emanating from the far end of the tunnel.
editmeta.edit_instruction_2: Transform the entire golden steampunk tunnel into translucent blue ice, freezing every gear, pipe, and arch into motionless crystalline forms with trapped vapor and cold highlights replacing the warm metallic reflections.
editmeta.edit_instruction_3: Shatter the frozen mechanical tunnel into glittering ice fragments that dissolve before reaching the street, revealing the original cobblestone town beneath a vivid green aurora in the night sky.
